scope: For quantitative mass spectrometry, THP-1 KO, WT, and KI cells were seeded at a density of 1 × 106 cells per well in a 12-well plate and incubated for 3 h at 37 °C and 5% CO2. The cells were then collected and washed with PBS twice.
